item.title: Podcow Oilers and NHL Daily: Monday, September 21, 2026
item.description: The Mike Babcock era in Edmonton launched with a convincing 5-2 preseason victory over Winnipeg as top prospect Isaac Howard claimed the system's top ranking. Teams across the NHL are adjusting to a condensed four-game preseason schedule while managing early training camp injuries and roster battles. Meanwhile, blockbuster trade speculation and rookie projections heat up league-wide as the 2026-27 campaign draws near.

item.title: Podcow Oilers and NHL Daily: Sunday, September 20, 2026
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers are rounding into regular season form following a decisive preseason victory over the Jets and further roster cuts to Bakersfield. Across the NHL, risky contract bets on young talent, key defensive recoveries in Toronto, and lingering off-season drama in Columbus and Detroit dominate training camp headlines. As European and minor league assignments solidify, teams across the league are making their final roster adjustments for the 2026-27 campaign.

item.title: Podcow Oilers and NHL Daily: Saturday, September 19, 2026
item.description: As Edmonton Oilers training camp gets underway under new head coach Mike Babcock, tough roster cutdowns loom ahead of the late-September waiver deadline. Meanwhile, contract friction heats up in Columbus with star center Adam Fantilli, and divisional rivals refine their rosters for the upcoming 2026-27 campaign.

item.title: Podcow Oilers and NHL Daily: Friday, September 18, 2026
item.description: Edmonton's training camp ramped up with early intensity as Connor McDavid gave the team a scare by crashing into the net during scrimmages, while Mike Babcock outlined his strategy to distribute ice time evenly across the forward corps. Around the league, Canadian rivals continue preparations with Toronto's Matthew Knies declaring full health, alongside early scouting looks at the 2027 draft class.
